title: ixd move: move a class or package with OpenRewrite so every reference is rewritten, inside a worktree
description: Package and class moves were done by hand: 857 import-only Edits, 618 replace_all Edits and 4 helper agents. Plain mv is allowed and git mv is denied, but the file move was never the cost; the package line and every import, static import, FQN and {@link} were. Evidence: ai-workspace reports/tool-review-2026-10-18.md item 4. Add `ixd move <class|package> <target package> [worktree]` running OpenRewrite ChangePackage/ChangeType through the autofix setup (resolved from ~/.m2), then compiling and printing the changed files. The moved files land as renames with import-only hunks, so wt stage-moves stages them for review.
definition-of-done:
1. ixd move moves a class and a package in a worktree and every reference (imports, static imports, FQNs, Javadoc links) is rewritten; the build passes.
2. stage-moves stages the result entirely.
testing-plan: 1. Move one class and one small package in a scratch worktree; paste the summary and the stage-moves output.
